__vite_ssr_exportName__("receiveProgressHistory", () => { try { return receiveProgressHistory } catch {} });
const __vite_ssr_import_0__ = await __vite_ssr_import__("/@id/__vite-browser-external:node:child_process", {"importedNames":["default"]});
const __vite_ssr_import_1__ = await __vite_ssr_import__("/@id/__vite-browser-external:node:crypto", {"importedNames":["default"]});
const __vite_ssr_import_2__ = await __vite_ssr_import__("/@id/__vite-browser-external:node:fs", {"importedNames":["default"]});
const __vite_ssr_import_3__ = await __vite_ssr_import__("/@id/__vite-browser-external:node:os", {"importedNames":["default"]});
const __vite_ssr_import_4__ = await __vite_ssr_import__("/@id/__vite-browser-external:node:path", {"importedNames":["default"]});
const __vite_ssr_import_5__ = await __vite_ssr_import__("/@id/__vite-browser-external:node:url", {"importedNames":["default"]});
 const execFileSync = __vite_ssr_import_0__.default["execFileSync"]; const spawn = __vite_ssr_import_0__.default["spawn"];
 const randomUUID = __vite_ssr_import_1__.default["randomUUID"];
 const createWriteStream = __vite_ssr_import_2__.default["createWriteStream"]; const mkdirSync = __vite_ssr_import_2__.default["mkdirSync"]; const readFileSync = __vite_ssr_import_2__.default["readFileSync"]; const realpathSync = __vite_ssr_import_2__.default["realpathSync"]; const writeFileSync = __vite_ssr_import_2__.default["writeFileSync"]

 const tmpdir = __vite_ssr_import_3__.default["tmpdir"];
 const dirname = __vite_ssr_import_4__.default["dirname"]; const resolve = __vite_ssr_import_4__.default["resolve"];
 const fileURLToPath = __vite_ssr_import_5__.default["fileURLToPath"];
function resolveProgressRoot(frozenRoot, moduleUrl = __vite_ssr_import_meta__.url) {
  const file = fileURLToPath(moduleUrl);
  const root = resolve(dirname(file), `../../../`);
  if (file !== resolve(
    root,
    `packages/query-db-collection/tests/queued-answer-progress-supervisor.ts`
  ))
    throw new Error(`unexpected progress supervisor location: ${file}`);
  if (root !== frozenRoot)
    throw new Error(
      `progress supervisor root differs from frozen root: ${root}`
    );
  return root;
};
async function receiveProgressHistory(history, observe) {
  const sourceFreeze = process.env.H02_PROGRESS_SOURCE_FREEZE;
  if (!sourceFreeze)
    throw new Error(
      `H02_PROGRESS_SOURCE_FREEZE is required before receiving execution`
    );
  const freeze = JSON.parse(
    readFileSync(sourceFreeze, `utf8`)
  );
  const root = resolveProgressRoot(freeze.worktree);
  const directory = resolve(
    tmpdir(),
    `h02-progress-${process.pid}-${randomUUID()}`
  );
  mkdirSync(directory);
  const historyPath = resolve(directory, `history.json`);
  const logPath = resolve(directory, `worker.log`);
  writeFileSync(historyPath, JSON.stringify(history, null, 2));
  const args = [
    `--max-old-space-size=384`,
    realpathSync(resolve(root, `node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs`)),
    `run`,
    `--config`,
    `scripts/h02-progress/vitest.config.ts`,
    `packages/query-db-collection/tests/queued-answer-progress.receiving.test.ts`
  ];
  const command = {
    executable: process.execPath,
    args,
    cwd: root,
    historyPath,
    directory,
    limits: { wallMs: 2e4, groupRssBytes: 1024 ** 3, nodeHeapMiB: 384 }
  };
  writeFileSync(
    resolve(directory, `prepared.json`),
    JSON.stringify(command, null, 2)
  );
  const log = createWriteStream(logPath);
  const child = spawn(process.execPath, args, {
    cwd: root,
    detached: true,
    stdio: [`ignore`, `pipe`, `pipe`],
    env: {
      ...process.env,
      H02_PROGRESS_WORKER_HISTORY: historyPath,
      H02_PROGRESS_BINDING_DIR: directory,
      H02_PROGRESS_SELECTED_ROOT: root.replace(/\/$/, ``)
    }
  });
  const outcome = {
    reason: `exited`,
    exitCode: null,
    signal: null,
    receipts: [],
    keyCallbacks: 0,
    prefixViolations: 0,
    warnings: 0,
    cleanupErrors: [],
    logPath
  };
  const start = Date.now();
  let maxSampledGroupRssBytes = 0;
  let latestGroupRows = [];
  let buffer = ``;
  let stderrTail = ``;
  let killAttempted = false;
  const save = (phase) => writeFileSync(
    resolve(directory, `supervisor.json`),
    JSON.stringify(
      {
        ...command,
        phase,
        pid: child.pid,
        elapsedMs: Date.now() - start,
        maxSampledGroupRssBytes,
        latestGroupRows,
        killAttempted,
        outcome
      },
      null,
      2
    )
  );
  save(`spawned`);
  const groupRows = () => {
    const output = execFileSync(`/bin/ps`, [`-axo`, `pid=,pgid=,rss=,args=`], {
      encoding: `utf8`,
      maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 ** 2
    });
    return output.split(`
`).filter((line) => Number(line.trim().split(/\s+/)[1]) === child.pid);
  };
  const kill = (reason) => {
    if (killAttempted || child.pid === void 0) return;
    outcome.reason = reason;
    killAttempted = true;
    save(`before-kill`);
    try {
      process.kill(-child.pid, `SIGKILL`);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof Error && `code` in error && error.code === `ESRCH`))
        outcome.cleanupErrors.push(String(error));
    }
  };
  const consume = (data) => {
    log.write(data);
    buffer += data.toString(`utf8`);
    for (; ; ) {
      const newline = buffer.indexOf(`
`);
      if (newline < 0) break;
      const line = buffer.slice(0, newline);
      buffer = buffer.slice(newline + 1);
      if (!line.startsWith(`{"h02":true,`)) continue;
      try {
        const receipt = JSON.parse(line);
        if (receipt.phase === `query-key-callback`) outcome.keyCallbacks++;
        if (receipt.phase === `actual-key-prefix` && receipt.valid !== true)
          outcome.prefixViolations++;
        if (receipt.phase === `warning`) outcome.warnings++;
        if ([
          `worker-start`,
          `conflicting-cache-premise`,
          `answer-queued`,
          `answer-executed`,
          `reload-start`,
          `public-change`,
          `cleanup-start`,
          `retained-publication`,
          `initial-publication`,
          `immediate-publication`,
          `final-publication`,
          `source-stack`,
          `worker-error`,
          `worker-cleaned`,
          `source-establishing-receipt`
        ].includes(receipt.phase)) {
          outcome.receipts.push(receipt);
        };
        observe(receipt);
      } catch (error) {
        outcome.primaryObservationError ??= error instanceof Error ? error.stack ?? error.message : String(error);
        kill(`observation`);
      }
    }
  };
  child.stdout.on(`data`, consume);
  child.stderr.on(`data`, (data) => {
    log.write(data);
    stderrTail = (stderrTail + data.toString(`utf8`)).slice(-4e3);
    if (/FATAL ERROR:.*heap|Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory/.test(
      stderrTail
    ))
      outcome.reason = `heap`;
  });
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    try {
      latestGroupRows = groupRows();
      const rss = latestGroupRows.reduce(
        (sum, line) => sum + Number(line.trim().split(/\s+/)[2]) * 1024,
        0
      );
      maxSampledGroupRssBytes = Math.max(maxSampledGroupRssBytes, rss);
      if (rss > command.limits.groupRssBytes) kill(`rss`);
      else if (Date.now() - start > command.limits.wallMs) kill(`wall`);
      save(`monitoring`);
    } catch (error) {
      outcome.cleanupErrors.push(`monitor: ${String(error)}`);
      kill(`observation`);
    }
  }, 100);
  try {
    await new Promise((done) => {
      child.once(`error`, (error) => {
        outcome.cleanupErrors.push(`spawn: ${String(error)}`);
        done();
      });
      child.once(`close`, (code, signal) => {
        outcome.exitCode = code;
        outcome.signal = signal;
        done();
      });
    });
  } finally {
    clearInterval(interval);
    try {
      latestGroupRows = groupRows();
      if (latestGroupRows.length > 0) {
        kill(`observation`);
        await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 100));
        latestGroupRows = groupRows();
        if (latestGroupRows.length > 0)
          outcome.cleanupErrors.push(
            `remaining process-group rows: ${latestGroupRows.join(` | `)}`
          );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      outcome.cleanupErrors.push(`final group check: ${String(error)}`);
    };
    await new Promise((done) => log.end(done));
    save(`final`);
  };
  try {
    execFileSync(
      process.execPath,
      [
        `--max-old-space-size=384`,
        resolve(root, `scripts/h02-progress/verify-bindings.mjs`),
        directory,
        sourceFreeze
      ],
      {
        cwd: root,
        encoding: `utf8`,
        timeout: 2e4,
        maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 ** 2
      }
    );
    const verification = JSON.parse(
      readFileSync(resolve(directory, `binding-verification.json`), `utf8`)
    );
    if (typeof verification !== `object` || verification === null || !(`status` in verification) || verification.status !== `bound`)
      throw new Error(`source binding did not establish bound status`);
    outcome.bindingStatus = `bound`;
  } catch (error) {
    outcome.bindingStatus = `unresolved`;
    outcome.bindingError = String(error);
  };
  save(`final-with-binding`);
  return outcome;
}
